baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction مع العسر يسرا places indefinite ease in company with the identified hardship rather than explicitly after it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hardship supplies the encompassing constrained condition while ease supplies an opening or readiness already operating inside that condition; the relation is simultaneous before it is sequential.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and severity supply the constraining condition within which the relational construction works.
Ready opening and ease supply an affordance located with, not only after, the constraint.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a later state that replaces hardship.
changed_reading.after: Within the identified hardship there is already an as-yet-indefinite opening by which it can be inhabited or traversed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite hardship and indefinite ease permit an asymmetry of scale, sharpened by the small-amount branch of ي س ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hard condition may occupy the whole named field while ease appears locally as a slight interval, margin, or dose; co-presence does not require equal size.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and severity provide the large-scale field experienced as hardship.
Littleness supplies the possibility that the accompanying ease is small yet operationally real.

changed_reading.before: The promised ease must be a complete counter-state proportionate to the hardship.
changed_reading.after: A slight but usable easing can coexist with a hardship that still names the whole situation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both nouns can be read materially through constricted means and available means while مع keeps them in one economy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Scarcity is not treated as absolute emptiness: a margin of solvency, resource, or capacity can remain present inside financial or material straitness.

activation_trace.role: Straitness of means turns hardship into a concrete resource constraint.
Prosperity and means supply the usable resource margin accompanying that constraint.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers only a general emotional contrast between distress and comfort.
changed_reading.after: Even within constricted means, some means-to-act accompanies the shortage and prevents it from being a closed totality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots themselves contrast premature coercion under ع س ر with readiness and pliant movement under ي س ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Part of hardness may arise from taking, speaking, or moving before preparation; ease is the co-present alternative of waiting for readiness and moving responsively.

activation_trace.role: Riding or taking before readiness supplies a mechanism in which mistimed force produces hardness.
Becoming ready and open supplies the alternative timing by which the same affair becomes tractable.
Pliant, responsive movement supplies the practical behavior of ease rather than mere comfort.

changed_reading.before: Hardship is an external obstacle, and ease is its external removal.
changed_reading.after: Hardness can be intensified by premature forcing, while a ready and responsive way through it is already available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening at the bodily and agentive source turns abstract ease into expanded working capacity inside the person who still occupies hardship.

activation_trace.role: Ready opening anchors the changed reading in the focus word for ease.
Opening and clarification supply an expansion operation rather than a later replacement event.
The source from which actions issue locates that expansion at the point where agency begins.

structural_cues: 94:1 places an opening at the addressee's chest before 94:6 predicates ease with hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening and an origin of action; I infer that opening creates room to act within hardship. A live alternative is that the opening is explanatory or affective without being the mechanism of ease.

changed_reading.before: Ease is an external circumstance that arrives alongside hardship.
changed_reading.after: Ease can be an internally opened capacity for action that accompanies an externally hard circumstance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a mechanical chain of lowering a heavy load from a back that audibly strains; ease becomes altered load placement and recovered compliance while the demanding terrain can remain.

activation_trace.role: Difficulty and severity anchor the still-demanding condition after the load relation changes.
Pliant movement supplies the regained mobility produced by better load distribution.
Putting something into a lower or settled position supplies the load-transfer operation.
The heavy burden supplies the force whose placement matters.
Creaking joints or back under weight supplies the observable failure signal of excessive loading.
The back supplies the load-bearing surface on which strain and relief can coexist.

structural_cues: 94:2-3 sequences lowering, burden, creaking, and back as a compact load-bearing scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowering, weight, a back, and its creak; I infer the causal arrow from redistributed force to renewed pliancy. The live alternative is a purely moral metaphor in which no mechanical model is intended.

changed_reading.before: Ease means that the burden or hard task disappears.
changed_reading.after: Ease is a changed load-bearing relation—lowering, support, and mobility—that can operate while the hard task remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two distinct opening images make ease dynamic: an initial expansion can be followed by closure or strain and then by reopening, so ease is recoverable rather than a single irreversible switch.

activation_trace.role: Ready opening anchors the recurrent process in the focus word.
Opening and clarification supply the first expansion in the sequence.
Reopening after closure supplies recurrence and reversibility rather than a one-time transition.

structural_cues: The opening cue in 94:1 and reopening cue in 94:3 precede the doubled hardship-ease statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening and reopening after closure; I infer a cycle in which access can close and be recovered. The alternative is that the two branches describe unrelated actions and only jointly reinforce a broad opening motif.

changed_reading.before: Ease is one decisive transition out of hardship.
changed_reading.after: Ease is the repeated recoverability of an opening within a condition that can tighten again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Raising and circulating mention activate a social channel of ease: recognition, audibility, and standing can increase the range of action even when private difficulty persists.

activation_trace.role: Expanded means anchor social standing as a possible form of usable ease.
Broadcasting news supplies outward propagation rather than merely vertical elevation.
Mention running on tongues supplies the network through which recognition circulates.
Repute and honor supply the social capital created by that circulation.

structural_cues: 94:4 places raised mention immediately before the repeated hardship-ease pair in 94:5-6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broadcast, circulating mention, and repute; I infer that these create social means that coexist with private strain. The alternative is that elevated mention is a separate benefit rather than an instance of the ease in 94:6.

changed_reading.before: Ease is only an inward feeling or a reduction of personal pain.
changed_reading.after: Ease may also be socially distributed capacity: a name carried, heard, and supported while personal hardship remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent re-predication turns co-presence into an iterative pattern: the same named hardship is met by a freshly asserted, indefinite opening rather than exhausted by one occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The first occurrence supplies the recurring field of difficulty.
The first ease occurrence supplies one ready opening within that field.
The repeated hardship keeps the difficult field present rather than narrating its disappearance.
The repeated ease renews the opening and makes recurrence visible.

structural_cues: 94:5 and 94:6 repeat the same root pair and relational construction in adjacent ayat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact adjacent repetition; I infer renewed or multiple access to ease rather than a single spent instance. The materially live alternative is emphatic restatement of one proposition with no multiplicative force.

changed_reading.before: The verse states one static companionship between one hardship and one ease.
changed_reading.after: The hard field can be met by repeatedly renewed openings; ease behaves as a pattern of access, not a one-use event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Vacancy after occupation feeds directly into standing up and exerting oneself, revising ease from terminal rest into released capacity that can be committed to another demanding act.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and opening anchor ease as newly available capacity.
Vacancy after occupation supplies the release of capacity.
Setting something upright and conspicuous supplies renewed directed engagement.
Exhausting toil keeps effort inside the semantic field that follows ease.

structural_cues: 94:7 follows the repeated promise with a conditional transition from becoming free to renewed exertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies post-occupation vacancy, upright setting, and toil; I infer that the opening of 94:6 enables renewed effort. The alternative is that 94:7 gives an ethical response after ease without redefining ease itself.

changed_reading.before: Ease is passive rest and the endpoint of exertion.
changed_reading.after: Ease is freed capacity: enough openness to stand up, choose a new task, and exert oneself again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurture, growth, spatial breadth, and directed desire turn ease into a cultivable vector: capacity increases by being oriented toward a sustaining source rather than remaining undirected comfort.

activation_trace.role: Prosperity and means anchor the changed reading in an increase of usable capacity.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the process by which capacity is cultivated.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growth keeps literal increase live within the split inventory.
Desire directed toward or away supplies the vector that channels available capacity.
Breadth and spatial extension supply room for that directed growth.

structural_cues: 94:8 follows renewed exertion by specifying a destination for desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, a split-mapped growth image, breadth, and directed desire; I infer a growth vector from orientation toward a sustaining source. The alternative is that these cues prescribe devotion after relief without describing the mechanics of ease.

changed_reading.before: Ease is an undirected pleasant state granted amid hardship.
changed_reading.after: Ease is capacity that can be nurtured, enlarged, and given direction toward its sustaining source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links bodily opening, material spreading, vessel-emptying, and spatial breadth into one capacity model. It remains anchored in the focus word's ready-opening branch and the construction of coexistence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a claim that the ayah denotes a literal vessel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The yusr branch of ready opening, placed with hardship by مع, can support the image of free volume inside a still-bounded system.

activation_trace.role: Ready opening anchors free capacity in the focus word for ease.
Spreading and cutting flesh supply a deliberately material image of making internal room.
The bodily chest supplies the bounded container in which expansion is imagined.
Pouring out and emptying a vessel supplies vacant volume after prior occupation.
A wide cavity or spatial extension supplies the resulting breadth.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a separate positive event added to hardship.
changed_reading.after: Ease can be imagined as free volume opened inside the same loaded system, permitting breath, movement, and renewed work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because both focus roots unexpectedly carry left-side images and the context cue uses the non-dominant mapping of و ز ر. It remains anchored in exact supplied branches and yields a coherent orientation mechanism, but it should be rendered as a spatial echo rather than a lexical replacement for hardship and ease.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired focus roots both admit lateral images, allowing مع to be tested as adjacency and reorientation rather than only scalar opposition.

activation_trace.role: The left side and left-handedness turn hardship's root into one lateral orientation.
The left side, left hand, and turning left make ease's root converge on the same lateral field.
The non-dominant split branch of inclination and turning supplies reorientation as a way of changing the load relation.
Turning a matter back-to-belly supplies a full change of aspect without changing the underlying matter.

changed_reading.before: Hardship and ease are only opposite quantities on one scale.
changed_reading.after: A branch-distant spatial echo lets ease appear as turning or changing aspect within the same terrain, not merely reducing its quantity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the lots-and-shares branch of ي س ر together with a context image that gathers lots. It remains anchored in the focus contrast between straitened and available means and offers a functional distribution mechanism, but downstream prose should qualify it as an allocative analogy, not as a gambling sense asserted for يسرا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The material-means reading of the focus pair can be crossed with the branch in which ي س ر apportions a scarce whole into shares.

activation_trace.role: Straitness of means supplies the scarcity problem that requires allocation.
Lots and division into shares supply allocation as a way to produce usable portions from one constrained whole.
The container that gathers lots supplies coordination of the distributive process.

changed_reading.before: Ease must mean that more total resource appears.
changed_reading.after: Ease may arise by apportioning a constrained whole into usable shares, so better distribution accompanies scarcity without first abolishing it.

strongest_changes: The focus construction first changed a sequential promise into simultaneous access: an opening is already with the hardship.
The load-bearing sequence changed ease from disappearance of burden into lowering, support, and recovered mobility.
Adjacent repetition changed one static ease into a repeatedly renewed pattern of openings.
The post-focus imperatives changed ease from terminal rest into released capacity for directed exertion and growth.
summary.what_was_special: The branch inventories kept several mechanisms alive at once: inner expansion, material load transfer, social circulation, temporal recurrence, resource margins, readiness, and deliberately contained spatial or allocative analogies. None requires the hardship to vanish before ease becomes real.
remaining_uncertainties: The scale reading depends on activating the small-amount branch of ي س ر rather than treating indefiniteness by itself as quantity.
The social, growth, and renewed-exertion models may describe neighboring benefits or responses rather than the internal semantics of يسرا.
The free-volume, lateral, and apportionment outliers are coherent cross-branch mechanisms but remain too branch-distant to state without explicit qualification.
Exact repetition can signal renewed openings or simply emphatic restatement; both readings remain live.
